ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) base with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and along surface abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity base across both visible lobes. High-contrast white/beige textured clusters at the far-left and far-right distal tips. Multiple thin, high-contrast white linear streaks distributed across the medial and distal surface of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees; depth is significant, extending into the main body of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular peaks and valleys (jagged notches). The left lobe trailing edge displays lower-amplitude, higher-frequency micro-serrations with a smoother overall profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized, high-contrast, irregular textured clusters (barnacle colonization) at the extreme lateral pixel coordinates of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, non-aligned white linear pixel trajectories (rake marks) varying in length and orientation, concentrated primarily on the left lobe's dorsal/ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular notches and tissue loss along the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive calcified-texture encrustation on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific sequence of deep serrations on the right lobe trailing edge provides a unique geometric signature.
